d: The home cooks pair up with Matt Gillan, Aiden Byrne, Frances Atkins and Theo Randall for head-to-heads.
Top chef Galton Blackiston' series of culinary challenges includes how to make a perfect beurre blanc sauce.
Chef Michael O'Hare's series of culinary challenges includes how to make the perfect scrambled eggs.

Gordon Ramsay visits Meson de Mesilla, a \\"luxury\\" Tuscan-style hotel in Las Cruces, New Mexico. Owner and child-star, Cali Szczawinski, purchased the hotel to perform Cher songs every night to a captive audience.

Gordon Ramsay checks in to The Monticello Hotel in Longview, Washington, owned by Phillip Lovingfoss: a wealthy individual with a fleet of classic cars and a drinking problem so serious that it is threatening to destroy his hotel and his life.

Gordon visits Applegate, Oregon, to try to rescue the failing Applegate River Lodge. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the owner, Richard Davis, is more interested in smoking cannabis than he is in fixing the problems of this family-built inn.

The first programme sees two Italian restaurants go head to head as they prepare a three course meal under Gordon’s watchful eye. Who will be good enough to wow the F Word diners and go on to fight for the title of The F Word’s Best Local Restaurant?

Two Indian restaurants go head to head. Curry is one of Britain’s favourite dishes so the pressure really is on.  Gordon continues his search for the world's best ingredients, travelling to Scotland to hunt deer to create a new recipe - Venison Masala.

In tonight’s programme, two French restaurants go head to head - Bouchon Bistrot, Hexham; and The French Table, Surbiton. They prepare a three course meal under Gordon’s watchful eye - including foie gras, rack of lamb, grey mullet and crepes suzette.

So far Gordon has found his best Italian, Indian, French, Chinese and in tonight’s programme, Gordon and his team travel around Britain looking for brilliant local Thai restaurants before inviting the best two to cook in the F Word restaurant.
The challenger is a master chef hailing from Kyoto. He has the support of the former Iron Chef Michiba and Dr. Yatori. Can the Iron Chef win this battle?
The challenger is a seafood expert who chooses and masterfully cooks gifts from the sea. He has apprenticed in the top kitchens of Japan. Which competitor will find the soul of the sea?
The challenger is a stubborn chef descended from a long line of Tokyo dwellers. The Iron Chef will have his hands full facing such a strong tradition.
The challenger is one of the few Mexican food specialists in Tokyo. This is a Latin duel at Kitchen Stadium.
Chef Ramsay returns to Classic American, DownCity and Davide to offer more advice and gauge the restaurants' progress — or lack thereof.
Chef Ramsay revisits Spanish Pavillion, Kingston Cafe and La Frite to judge their progress after his initial consultations.
Chef Ramsay visits a fifty-year-old steakhouse. Despite the restaurant's rich history, it's long overdue for a visual and culinary makeover.
